name: Stale-State Disagreement & Watchdog Reset Recovery
description: Validates swarm consensus under stale/delayed telemetry (Master Blueprint v2.0 Section 3.10 & 3.11). SAT-01 experiences telemetry epoch desynchronization and stale local state at t=2.0s. The recovery engine detects the divergence, records a trust penalty, initiates an automated onboard flight computer watchdog reset (RESET_COMPUTE), and safely restores SAT-01 to full NOMINAL operational health.

scheduled_faults.description: Onboard state epoch desynchronization causing stale consensus telemetry on SAT-01
